async def act(page):
    # Type 'state:opened label:bug' into the searchbox to filter for opened bug issues
    searchbox = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Search or filter results...')
    await searchbox.fill('state:opened label:bug')
    await searchbox.press('Enter')
    # Wait for the page to update after filtering
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Get all links on the page
    all_links = page.get_by_role('link')
    count = await all_links.count()
    issue_titles = []
    for i in range(count):
        link = all_links.nth(i)
        href = await link.get_attribute('href')
        if href and href.startswith('/a11yproject/a11yproject.com/issues/'):
            title = await link.text_content()
            issue_titles.append(title)
    # Print the list of issue titles
    print(issue_titles)
